nodes.label: Flow: Tailoring a Resume

nodes.rationale: The AI only rewords and selects; everything it writes is checked against the user's own text before it is kept.

nodes.label: Signed-in AI (Gemini CLI / Claude Code)
nodes.community_name: Flow: AI With API Key or Own Account
nodes.rationale: Use the user's own Google/Claude plan instead of an API key; runs in an empty temp folder; Perplexity has no official sign-in tool and chat websites are never automated.

nodes.label: Tailoring Conflict Rules
nodes.community_name: Flow: AI With API Key or Own Account
nodes.rationale: Ranking order among relevant entries; substantial work beats coursework; jobs/education always kept; confirmed skills lead within 18-skill limit; word limit beats bullet counts; hackathon+project merged once to keep ATS keywords.

nodes.label: Grounding Guarantees (entry match, number check, borrowed names)

nodes.label: AI Only On Click (token-cost confirmation)
nodes.community_name: Flow: AI With API Key or Own Account
nodes.rationale: Nothing calls the AI automatically; every ✦ action confirms provider/model and warns of token cost.

nodes.label: Grounded AI (fact-check + rule check)
nodes.community_name: Flow: AI With API Key or Own Account
nodes.rationale: AI may only use facts from the user's resume and notes; employers, titles, dates pinned, invented numbers undone, unsupported skills dropped.
